g.text: The latency budget -- and the funnel that protects it

text.tspan: The budget only holds because of the funnel.
If the CDN and Redis hit rates fall, every tier below them
sees several times the traffic it was sized for --
which is how a cache problem presents as a database outage.

g.text: Static and cacheable GETs never go further
Token verified locally, no database call
Sharded so no single primary takes it all
